blocks.text: When the monomer(s) contain C=C bonds, addition polymerisation takes place, for example with ethene, propene and phenylethene (styrene). Usually homopolymers are formed, but sometimes two different monomers with double bonds can be polymerised together to give a copolymer, such as the copolymer of ethene and propenoic acid (CH2=CH-COOH).
